resources.string: The server\'s certificate has changed. Open it again from the start screen to check the new one.
No app on this phone opens this link.
The app can\'t reach this server at its own address, so it opens it through your group\'s relay. Signing in with the password and saving files work only at the server\'s own address.
Saving files works only at the server\'s own address, not over the relay.
